blocks.content: Brick Breaker is one of those games that looks simple at first. You control a paddle, bounce a ball, and break bricks.
But as you build it, you start to see what is really going on. It brings together the core pieces of a canvas game like drawing, animation, input, and collision.
We will go step by step and build each part together.
Next, let's look at how the game is structured. Click on Next Lesson to continue.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
